trades.reasoning: RSI 66.7 in bullish zone with MACD bullish crossover, rising histogram, and price above SMA-20 offers solid momentum confirmation and sector diversification away from existing semiconductor-heavy holdings.

decisions.briefing: Markets were roughly flat today (NASDAQ -0.3%, S&P 500 -0.2%), a neutral session with no clear directional catalyst. With cash above the deployment threshold and open slots available, we added one medium-conviction position in EPAM on strong technical signals while holding the rest of the portfolio steady and saving remaining dry powder for a clearer risk-on setup.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today in a quiet, directionless session with no major catalyst driving broad risk appetite. Trading volume and volatility stayed subdued, consistent with a market pausing to digest recent gains rather than reacting to new information. Individual stocks with strong technical setups, like EPAM, continued to show momentum even as the broader indices were flat.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市窄幅震盪，納指及標普500分別小跌0.3%及0.2%，市場缺乏明確方向，屬於消化近期升幅的觀望格局。成交量及波幅均維持平靜,反映投資者未有明顯加碼或減碼意欲。不過個別具強勁技術形態的股份，例如EPAM，即使大市平淡仍展現上升動能。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum confirmation means only acting on a bullish signal when multiple indicators agree — for example RSI in a healthy range, a MACD crossover, and price trading above its moving average all pointing the same way. Relying on just one signal (like RSI alone) can lead to false starts, so combining signals reduces the chance of buying into a fakeout.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能確認是指只有在多項技術指標同時發出看好訊號時才採取行動，例如RSI處於健康區間、MACD出現黃金交叉，以及股價高於其移動平均線。單靠一個指標（例如只看RSI）容易誤判，結合多項訊號可以降低追高落空的風險。
